# homeassistant_person (Resource)

A person: someone whose presence Home Assistant tracks with device trackers, optionally linked to a user. Persons defined in YAML cannot be managed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "homeassistant_user" "jane" {
  name     = "Jane"
  username = "jane"
  password = var.jane_password
}

# Jane is home when her phone or her laptop is.
resource "homeassistant_person" "jane" {
  name            = "Jane"
  user_id         = homeassistant_user.jane.id
  device_trackers = ["device_tracker.jane_phone", "device_tracker.jane_laptop"]
}

# A person without a user, e.g. a child without a login.
resource "homeassistant_person" "kid" {
  id              = "kid"
  name            = "Alex"
  device_trackers = ["device_tracker.alex_watch"]
}

variable "jane_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name. Changing it renames the person in place.

### Optional

- `device_trackers` (Set of String) Entity IDs of the `device_tracker` entities that track the person. Home Assistant removes a tracker from the person when its entity is deleted. Defaults to none.
- `id` (String) Person ID, a slug such as `jane_doe`. Home Assistant derives it from `name` when the person is created, and keeps it when the person is renamed. Set it to choose the ID yourself. Changing it replaces the person. Creation fails if the ID is taken. Import with this ID.
- `picture` (String) URL of the picture, e.g. `/api/image/serve/<id>/512x512` for an image uploaded to Home Assistant.
- `user_id` (String) ID of the user this person is, e.g. `homeassistant_user.jane.id`. A user can belong to only one person. When the user is deleted, Home Assistant unlinks it.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a person by its ID. Persons defined in YAML cannot be imported.
tofu import homeassistant_person.jane jane
```
